versions.subject: feat: update winget related rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\winget.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'winget.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'source '
        - 'add '
        - 'http://'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\winget.exe" OR OriginalFileName="winget.exe" CommandLine="*source *" CommandLine="*add *" CommandLine="*http://*"
